purpose: Replace the generic observation-admissibility predicate with an explicit DevAdm_x-to-AdmObs_x mapping while preserving delta_a as the whole-continuation filter.

excl_obs_binding.admissible_family: Omega_x_adm := {o in Omega_obs | AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = TRUE}
excl_obs_binding.excluded_family: Omega_x_exc := {o in Omega_obs | AdmObs_x(o; B_x, D_rel, R) = FALSE}
excl_obs_binding.undefined_invocation: If any required orientation mapping is UNDEFINED, Excl_obs_x returns UNDEFINED_INVOCATION unless partial-family semantics are explicitly declared.

gamma_O_bridge.definition: Gamma_O(q, c, R, -(i)) := AdmObs_x(ObsOrient(q); B_x(c), D_rel(c), R)
gamma_O_bridge.full_delta_a_context: delta_a(Q; c, R, -(i)) := {q in Q | Gamma_E(q) AND Gamma_R(q) AND Gamma_T(q) AND Gamma_O(q)}
gamma_O_bridge.restriction: AdmObs_x supplies at most Gamma_O and cannot independently establish whole-continuation admissibility.

tests.expected: ADMISSIBLE maps to TRUE and preserves provenance.
INADMISSIBLE maps to FALSE and records orientation exclusion.
UNDEFINED maps to UNDEFINED and blocks total exclusion classification.
AdmObs_x does not equal delta_a and does not bypass Gamma_E, Gamma_R, or Gamma_T.
Empty Omega_x_adm does not imply symmetry absence or zero-state.

next_action: Human review of the explicit mapping and the UNDEFINED partial-family policy.
